name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: A single-plane sidebar with spacious link rhythm, logical-start selection, and soft deterministic entry motion

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Wordmark printed above the links. Blank or missing falls back to HyperFrames.

variables.label: Width
variables.description: Width of the whole rail. Values outside the range clamp to the nearest end and anything that is not a number falls back to 240.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the marker on the selected link. theme leaves the shared accent token in charge, the rest borrow a data colour from the same palette.

variables.label: Theme
variables.description: Operator Black dark surface or the light-frame token set.
